name: Quintorius, Loremaster
oracle_text:
Vigilance
At the beginning of your end step, exile target noncreature, nonland card from your graveyard. Create a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token.
{1}{R}{W}, {T}, Sacrifice a Spirit: Choose target card exiled with Quintorius. You may cast that card this turn without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, put it on the bottom of its owner's library instead.

needs.what: a 3/2 red and white Spirit creature token (id spirit_3_2_rw)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has only spirit_1_1_c, spirit_1_1_w_flying and spirit_2_2_w and no 3/2 red-white Spirit; a near token would change the card

needs.what: a rider on a free-cast permission granted to a card in exile (grant_playable / play_exiled with playable_free, playable_this_turn): if the spell cast that way would be put into a graveyard (resolving, countered or fizzling), it goes to the bottom of its owner's library instead
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_playable carries playable, playable_free, playable_this_turn, as_flashback and limit, and play_exiled carries as/exiles/objects, but none attaches a destination replacement to the resulting spell; as_flashback exiles rather than tucks, and tucks_itself is a card-level rider on the card's own printed text, not something granted to another card
